NYMPH_KEYWORD_CONCEIVE.title: Conceive
NYMPH_KEYWORD_CONCEIVE.description: Gain the corresponding amount of additional Thought.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_NARRATE.title: Narrate
NYMPH_KEYWORD_NARRATE.description: If you have enough [gold]Thought[/gold], convert the corresponding amount of [gold]Thought[/gold] into [gold]Block[/gold], then trigger any follow-up effect.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_FULL_NARRATE.title: Full Narration
NYMPH_KEYWORD_FULL_NARRATE.description: Convert all [gold]Thought[/gold] into [gold]Block[/gold], then trigger any follow-up effect.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_RECREATE.title: Recreate Card
NYMPH_KEYWORD_RECREATE.description: Transform the target card into a random card from this character's card pool, add it to your Hand, and preserve its upgrade status.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_PERMANENT_RECREATE.title: Permanent Recreate
NYMPH_KEYWORD_PERMANENT_RECREATE.descrip: Permanently transform the target card and its Deck version into a random card from this character's card pool while preserving its upgrade status.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_RECREATE_POTION.title: Recreate Potion
NYMPH_KEYWORD_RECREATE_RELIC.title: Recreate Relic
NYMPH_KEYWORD_RECREATE_RELIC.description: Transform into a random Relic of the same rarity.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration
NYMPH_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION.description: A series of [gold]Inspiration Cards[/gold]. At the start of combat, choose one of them to play.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION_CARD.title: Inspiration Card
NYMPH_KEYWORD_INSPIRATION_CARD.descripti: Single-use. Removed from the Inspiration pile after being played.
NYMPH_KEYWORD_THRESHOLD.title: Confusion Threshold
NYMPH_KEYWORD_THRESHOLD.description:
When Thought reaches the [gold]Confusion Threshold[/gold], enter [gold]Confused[/gold].
The [gold]Obstruction Threshold[/gold] equals [blue]2[/blue] times the Confusion Threshold.
